description: This file defines an abstract class OnClickConverter for converting and resolving Android onClick handler references within IntelliJ IDEA plugin development, including nested classes and specific converter instances for layout and menu contexts.

classes.name: OnClickConverter
classes.description: An abstract class for converting Android onClick handler references, with nested classes for reference resolution and variants.

classes.name: MyReference
classes.description: A nested class extending PsiPolyVariantReferenceBase for resolving onClick method references.

classes.name: MyResolveResult
classes.description: A nested class representing the result of resolving a reference, including signature correctness.

methods.name: checkSignature
methods.description: Checks if a method has a valid signature for an onClick handler.

methods.name: findHandlerMethod
methods.description: Finds if a class contains a method matching the given onClick handler name with a valid signature.

methods.name: createLookupElement
methods.description: Creates a lookup element for code completion suggestions for a method.
